description: This file defines the ConditionDAO interface which specifies database operations related to Condition objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting Condition entities, as well as querying conditions by patient, encounter, and UUID.

classes.name: ConditionDAO
classes.description: An interface defining database operations for managing Condition objects.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition using its UUID.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Fetches all active conditions linked to a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all conditions associated with a given patient.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches conditions associated with a specific encounter, may throw APIException.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a Condition in the database.

methods.name: deleteCondition
methods.description: Removes a Condition from the database, may throw DAOException.
